article.title: Pursuit of offenders into other jurisdictions
article.content: A police officer may, for the purpose of arresting without warrant any person whom he is authorised to arrest, pursue such person into any place in India.
article.html:
45Pursuit of offenders into other jurisdictions

Section 45 · Chapter V

A police officer may, for the purpose of arresting without warrant any person whom he is authorised to arrest, pursue such person into any place in India.
